claude_proposed_widenings.name: ModifySpeedEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit speed reduction (-10 ft until start of next turn) requires a new variant in the Effect union. The v4 atom modify_speed exists, but Effect = DamageEffect | NoneEffect — no surface type for modify_speed in an Effect position.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: onHit multi-effect support
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Ray of Frost delivers both damage AND speed reduction on the same hit. The current onHit: Effect field accepts a single effect. Encoding both requires either onHit: ReadonlyArray<Effect> or a CompositeEffect variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
